entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need some help with a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Chris Miller, and the order number is VF-92104.

Thanks, Chris. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series cycling jersey. To make sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the item, or is it more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. The jersey is just the wrong size. I waited a bit to try it on and it's far too tight in the shoulders.

I understand completely. Let me just confirm the delivery date... It looks like it arrived 54 days ago. You're well within our 90-day return window, so I can definitely process an exchange or a full refund for you.

Oh, that's great. I'd like to do an exchange for the next size up. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of repackaging it and sending it back, is there any chance you could offer a small credit or a discount code for a future order?

I understand the request, Chris. While our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits on a standard size exchange, I can absolutely make sure there are no shipping charges for your new jersey being sent out. We'll cover that for you.
Okay, waiving the shipping fee for the new item is a fair compromise. I can agree to that. Let's proceed with the exchange.

Excellent. I have processed the exchange in the system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid return label. Just send the jersey that's too tight back to us, and we'll get the correct size shipped out as soon as the return is in transit.
Sounds perfect. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Chris. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
